say:0:1910806001:1.text: I need to go home... My family is still waiting for me...
say:0:1910806001:1.source_cn: 家……我要回家，家人，还在等我……

say:1:1910806002:1.text: Family should always stay together. But where is our home...? What is home exactly...?
say:1:1910806002:1.source_cn: 家人，应该永远在一起。可是，家在哪里……家是什么？

say:3:1910806004:1.text: 你竭尽全力，施展着过去曾学习过的聚灵魔法，试图挽救着这些弥散的生灵。
say:3:1910806004:1.source_cn: 你竭尽全力，施展着过去曾学习过的聚灵魔法，试图挽救着这...

say:4:1910806005:1.text: But no spirit-gathering spell, however powerful, can save them. The points of light keep drifting away, and the lingering echoes grow weaker...
